climb-then-collect.about: The Phase 3b player, with its settings as they were. Climbs on the strongest enemy it gives 60% or better, tries a boss from 35%, gives a boss up for the run after 4 losses, shops after every win, uses Salvage every run, and turns to collecting drops once it has outgrown what it can beat.

long-shot.about: DV-3's risk. Plays as the Phase 3b player does, except that it keeps at a boss for up to 15 losses where that player stops at 4, and that with its last energy it throws itself at the boss at any odds from 2%, up to 15 times. Where a loss is charged it holds 5 energy back for that.

cautious.about: Fights only what it gives 80% or better, tries a boss only from 70%, and walks away from a boss after 2 losses.

like-michael.about: Fitted to the one recorded playthrough. Fights only what it gives 85% or better, puts over half its points into Life, shops once at the end of a run, does not use Salvage or go looking for drops, and tries a boss from 20%, up to 5 times a run.
